Name: Style-Compromise Artisan Good Icons Lite (SCAGI Lite)
Author: Cheerybelle
Description:
This mod modifies the icons for jelly, pickles, wine, juice, and honey.
Colours are supported for jelly, pickles, wine, and juice. [size=1](This is a vanilla feature introduced in Stardew Valley 1.6.x.)[/size]

This was originally intended as an alternative to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5220]the original SCAGI[/url] for use with Stardew Valley 1.6.x, but they can be used together.

Two versions of SCAGI Lite are available:
The standard version keeps the visual changes to keg products in 1.6.x (with some tweaking to the default wine icon).
The Classic version changes the designs of the keg products to be like the original SCAGI.
